runbill v0.3.0

- `--by branch` / `--by event` (or `--by branch,event`): break billed minutes and cost down by head branch and by trigger event (push, pull_request, schedule, …), ranked by cost. Same per-job round-up, so each table adds up to the total. Works in `runbill report`, `runbill org` (branches as `repo › branch`), `runbill demo`, and as the Action's new `by` input. Fork PRs show as `owner:branch`.
- Text table headers now line up with their columns; long names are cut with `…`.
- `--top` must be 1 or more.

Action: `uses: Blackman99/runbill@v0.3.0` · Install: `pipx install git+https://github.com/Blackman99/runbill@v0.3.0` · Docs: https://blackman99.github.io/runbill/docs/
